newsitem.title: MEXICO: Denmark opens trade office in northern Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Denmark opens trade office in northern Mexico.

text.p: Denmark opened a trade office here in this northern industrial city on Monday, hoping to boost economic ties betweem the European nation and Mexico.
"Today we are inaugurating the trade delegation of Denmark in Monterrey, the second European nation to do so after Britain," Denmark's trade delegate Niels Thomsen told a media conference.
Thomsen said the office would serve as the link for Mexican businessmen to export or import products with Denmark.
Two way trade betwen the two nations totals close to $90 million.
"According to statistics, Mexico exported $18.7 million of products to Denmark in 1996 and imported $70.7 million," Thomsen said.
